# Welcome to Coldharbour Blue

Independent Cinema & Events Space with a heavy focus on South London community

Regular music & comedy nights

Yard Sale Pizza & Black Lines Cocktails

Taking over the former site of Whirled Cinema, which opened its doors in 2010. We’re proud to add to a legacy of independent cinema. Screening the best of new releases, art-house, classics and documentaries

**Cinema Membership is £15 a month or £150 a year (for you and a guest)**

**What does a membership get you?**

- **6 free screenings a month (4 film releases, a classic, and a documentary)**
- **£10 tickets to live theatre recordings in partnership with the National Theatre**
- **£5 pints and deals on signature cocktails from Black Lines**
- **No need to book – just turn up, grab a drink and take a seat!**

[Membership](https://www.coldharbourblue.com/product/membership/) [Hire Now](#hire-form)

Exploding Cinema, the 1991 Brixton-born legendary underground film show, arrives home with a show for the first time at Coldharbour Blue on 26th November 2026. Featuring the very latest in whatever films people are making and however they are making them, Exploding Cinema’s radical open-access policy means every show features shorts that you would never see anywhere else.
